verdict.rationale: uv's project files are open, standard formats (pyproject.toml, plain-text uv.lock) rather than proprietary, and it offers a pip-compatible interface plus requirements.txt import (uv add -r) that eases migrating away — supporting the 'no lock-in' spirit of the story. However, there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated data/lockfile export-to-requirements.txt command or broader data-portability documentation. Missing for 10: explicit uv-to-standard-format export tooling (e.g., uv export to requirements.txt), documentation framing data portability/exit strategy, and independent confirmation that users can fully migrate off uv without friction.
